question: Which of the following actions does insulin exert on liver tissue?

options.opa: It inhibits the uptake of glucose.
options.opc: Inhibits the synthesis of fatty acids.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Insulin" -> "Activates glycogen synthesis" -> 95% CHAIN: "Insulin" -> "Inhibits the synthesis of fatty acids" -> 90% CHAIN: "Insulin" -> "Inhibits the uptake of glucose" -> 80% CHAIN: "Insulin" -> "Activates lipolysis" -> 20% CHAIN: "Insulin" -> "Activates glycogenolysis" -> 95%
analysis: Insulin exerts its action on liver tissue by promoting the storage of glucose in the form of glycogen. This helps in lowering blood glucose levels.
